verdict.rationale: The README documents a very short install path: two `/plugin` commands, plus alternatives of pasting a single SKILL.md into a chat or copying folders into `.claude/skills/`. It also explains that the skills run in order through a `replica/` folder. That points to fast onboarding, but nothing shows the setup working end to end or within any particular time. Missing for 10: a stated or demonstrated under-five-minute timeline, a first-run verification step confirming the skill works, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the install flow.
